market.question: Will London have between 20-25mm of precipitation in May?

assessment.reasoning: Heathrow May average rainfall is ~45-50mm with most months in the 30-70mm range historically. The 20-25mm bracket is the dry side of normal but achievable; given typical year-to-year variance the right-tail of months below 30mm is maybe 25-30% and the 5mm-wide 20-25mm bin captures only a portion.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether the long-range pattern delivers a notably dry May; bin is narrow (5mm).
